searches.reason: Investigate whether titles and descriptions can supply specific item relationships beyond broad interaction similarity. Seek lightweight text encoders trained from scratch and integrated into the GRU network, without pretrained weights or separate scoring models. Treat compatibility and current need as unverified hypotheses.

searches.reason: Explore an objective-level alternative to the previous BPR-max proposal: sampled listwise learning that targets competition near the top ten. Electronics motivates investigating difficult comparisons, but sampled training margins do not establish validation gains. Seek efficient methods with explicit sampling corrections and false-negative handling.
